FAQ.title: Got Questions? We Have Answers.
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know about solar installation, performance, maintenance, and Paa Solar long-term service commitments.
FAQ.moreQuestionsSub: Our EPC solar engineers are ready to assist with custom engineering sizing & DISCOM guidelines.
FAQ.q1: How long do solar panels last?
FAQ.a1: Most solar panels have a lifespan of 25–30 years with gradual performance degradation.
FAQ.q2: What maintenance is required for solar systems?
FAQ.a2: Regular cleaning, periodic inspections, and inverter checks ensure optimal performance.
FAQ.q3: Does solar work during cloudy days or rain?
FAQ.a3: Yes, Solar panels continue to generate electricity, though at reduced output.
FAQ.q4: How much space is required for solar installation?
FAQ.a4: Space requirements depend on system capacity, module type, and layout.
FAQ.q5: Is maintenance required for solar systems?
FAQ.a5: Solar systems need minimal maintenance—just periodic cleaning and annual inspections to ensure peak performance and long-term reliability.
FAQ.a6: Yes, Solar significantly reduces electricity bills and offers attractive long-term returns.
FAQ.q7: Does Paa Solar provide warranties and O&M support?
FAQ.a7: Yes, Paa Solar offers product warranties, performance guarantees, and comprehensive O&M services.
